university.name: Angeles University Foundation
university.tagline: Forming truly excellent professionals, imbued with a Catholic identity.
university.description: Angeles University Foundation (AUF) is a premier Catholic university in Central Luzon committed to academic excellence, Catholic values, and community service.
university.address: MacArthur Highway, Angeles City, Pampanga, Philippines 2009
university.vision: AUF envisions itself as a leading Catholic university in Asia committed to excellence through instruction, research, and community service.
university.mission: AUF commits itself to form truly excellent and ethical graduates who are committed to truth, justice, and the common good through quality education guided by Catholic values.

colleges.name: Graduate School
colleges.description: The Graduate School provides advanced education and professional training, fostering research and innovation for global competitiveness.
colleges.vision: To be a leading center for advanced studies and research in the Asia-Pacific region.
colleges.mission: To advance knowledge and professional practice through high-impact research, innovative teaching, and relevant community engagement.

colleges.name: School of Law
colleges.description: The School of Law produces lawyers and legal professionals committed to justice, ethical practice, and the rule of law in service of the Filipino people.
colleges.vision: To be a premier law school producing competent, ethical, and socially responsible legal professionals.
colleges.mission: To develop lawyers and legal professionals with a deep commitment to justice, human dignity, and the common good through rigorous legal education.

colleges.name: School of Medicine
colleges.description: The School of Medicine shapes compassionate and highly competent physicians dedicated to healthcare excellence and community service.
colleges.vision: To be a center of excellence in medical education, producing globally competitive and socially responsive physicians.
colleges.mission: To provide outstanding medical education, foster impactful research, and deliver compassionate healthcare services.

colleges.name: College of Allied Medical Professions
colleges.description: The College of Allied Medical Professions produces competent health professionals dedicated to holistic patient care and wellness promotion.
colleges.vision: To be a leading institution developing compassionate and Christ-centered allied health professionals.
colleges.mission: To produce globally competent allied health professionals through excellence in health education, research, and community service.

colleges.name: College of Arts and Sciences
colleges.description: The College of Arts and Sciences provides a broad liberal arts and sciences education, developing well-rounded graduates prepared for leadership in diverse fields.
colleges.vision: To be a premier college developing globally competent graduates who are critical thinkers and ethical leaders.
colleges.mission: To provide quality education in arts and sciences through rigorous academic programs, meaningful research, and transformative community engagement.

colleges.name: College of Business and Accountancy
colleges.description: The College of Business and Accountancy prepares future business leaders with a strong foundation in management, finance, marketing, and accounting.
colleges.vision: To be a center of excellence in business education producing globally competitive and ethical business professionals.
colleges.mission: To develop competent, innovative, and socially responsible business leaders through quality education, relevant research, and meaningful community partnerships.

colleges.name: College of Criminal Justice Education
colleges.description: The College of Criminal Justice Education molds disciplined and ethical law enforcers and public safety professionals.
colleges.vision: To be a recognized leader in criminal justice education and public safety training.
colleges.mission: To deliver quality instruction and practical training that form competent, honest, and dedicated criminal justice practitioners.

colleges.name: College of Computer Studies
colleges.description: The College of Computer Studies fosters innovation through programs in computer science and information technology, preparing graduates for the digital age.
colleges.vision: To be a leading college in computing, driving innovation and technological advancement in the region.
colleges.mission: To produce technically excellent, creative, and ethical computing professionals through rigorous academic programs and industry collaboration.

colleges.name: College of Education
colleges.description: The College of Education shapes the future of learning by developing passionate, skilled, and values-driven educators committed to transformative teaching.
colleges.vision: To be a center of excellence in teacher education producing globally competitive and Christ-centered educators.
colleges.mission: To develop highly qualified, reflective, and ethical educators who are committed to continuous professional growth and service to the community.

colleges.name: College of Engineering and Architecture
colleges.description: The College of Engineering and Architecture develops skilled professionals who apply scientific, technological, and design knowledge to solve real-world problems.

contact.address: Engineering and Architecture Building, AUF Campus

colleges.vision: To be a premier college producing globally competitive, innovative, and ethically responsible engineers and architects.
colleges.mission: To provide quality education that integrates technical excellence, design thinking, research, and social responsibility.

colleges.name: College of Nursing
colleges.description: The College of Nursing produces exceptional nursing professionals equipped with the clinical skills, empathy, and leadership needed in modern healthcare.
colleges.vision: To be a world-class institution for nursing education producing culturally-competent and compassionate nurses.
colleges.mission: To deliver excellence in nursing education through evidence-based practice, rigorous clinical training, and holistic care principles.

colleges.name: AUF Integrated School
colleges.description: The AUF Integrated School provides foundational education deeply rooted in Catholic values, preparing students for higher education and lifelong learning.
colleges.vision: To be a model Catholic basic education institution shaping young minds to be academically excellent and morally upright.
colleges.mission: To foster the holistic development of learners through a robust curriculum, dynamic learning environments, and strong spiritual formation.
